title: Athabaskan languages - Wikipedia
text: Athabaskan, also known as Dene, is a large branch of the Na-Dene language family of North America, located in western North America in three areal language groups: Northern, Pacific Coast and Southern.

title: Plains Apache - Wikipedia
text: The Plains Apache are a small Southern Athabaskan tribe who live on the Southern Plains of North America, in close association with the linguistically unrelated Kiowa Tribe.
